metadata.original_title: 5 Min Warm up exercises before workout | Why warm up?
metadata.clean_title: 5 Min Warm up exercises before workout Why warm up
metadata.description:
Any workout is incomplete without a proper warm up. An ideal warm up lasts 5 minutes. 

Why  warm up?

* A good warm prepares you mentally and physically for the workout.
* It reduces the risk of injuries.
* It increases the blood flow to muscles and decreases the muscle viscosity.
* It increases the delivery of oxygen and other nutrients to the muscles.
* A good warm increases the hormonal production responsible for energy.
* It lubricates the joints thus increasing the range of motion.

Warm Up Routine:

* 30 Jumps
* 20 Alter Jumps
* 15 Side Jumps
* 10 Arm Stretches
* 10 Parallel Arms
* 10 Both way Arms
* 30 Side Kicks
* 5 Back Stretches
* 10 Leg Stretches
* 1 Set of  Push ups
*  20 Side Circles
* 20 Side Circles (clockwise)
* 10 Hand Circles
* 10 Hand Circles (clockwise)
* 15 Oblique Stretches
* Shoulder Stretch
* 15 Cross Stretches 

Hope you liked it :)

Please Subscribe : https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

I wish you good health.
Fit Tuber
